taskVersion.name: pilot-ves-label-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Odufor, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model from the published survey:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

The paper labels this station's curve as AK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Odufor, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the paper's curve-type label does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Report: Station Odufor, Etche LGA**

The vertical electrical sounding (VES) profile at Station Odufor identifies a 4-layer geoelectric sequence:
- **Layer 1:** 20.32 Ω·m, thickness 0.14 m (depth to base: 0.14 m)
- **Layer 2:** 851.16 Ω·m, thickness 1.10 m (depth to base: 1.24 m)
- **Layer 3:** 2511.90 Ω·m, thickness 15.80 m (depth to base: 17.04 m)
- **Layer 4:** 1345.00 Ω·m (basal substratum)

Resistivity progression:
- Layers 1–2–3: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3$ (A-type)
- Layers 2–3–4: $\rho_2 < \rho_3 > \rho_4$ (K-type)

Combining these successive triplets yields an **AK-type** curve, which accurately matches the published survey classification.

{"curve_type_stated": "AK", "label_issue_flagged": false}
